# Erik David Galindo · Miami Real Estate

> Erik David Galindo is a Florida-licensed real estate advisor with Parsiani Real Estate (2480 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33137). He guides buyers, sellers, investors and families relocating to Miami, with a focus on luxury condominiums and pre-construction in Brickell, Edgewater, Downtown Miami, the Design District and Miami Beach. He works in English and Spanish.

Contact: +1 (305) 902-0139 · Erik@Parsiani.com · Instagram @erikdavid_lifestyle

Prices, availability and terms on this site change and must be confirmed with Erik before any decision.

## Neighborhood guides
- [Miami neighborhoods overview](https://www.erikdavidg.com/neighborhoods.html): how to compare areas, buying in Miami and an introduction to Erik
- [Brickell](https://www.erikdavidg.com/neighborhoods-brickell.html): Miami's financial district on Biscayne Bay
- [Edgewater](https://www.erikdavidg.com/neighborhoods-edgewater.html): residential towers on the western shore of Biscayne Bay
- [Downtown Miami](https://www.erikdavidg.com/neighborhoods-downtown-miami.html): parks, museums and high-rises between the Miami River and the museum district
- [Design District](https://www.erikdavidg.com/neighborhoods-design-district.html): art, design, architecture and luxury retail
- [Miami Beach](https://www.erikdavidg.com/neighborhoods-miami-beach.html): South Beach, Mid-Beach and North Beach between the ocean and the bay
